data_subject_requests_refusal_reason.name: data_subject_requests_refusal_reason
data_subject_requests_refusal_reason.value: "data_subject_requests"."outcome" IS DISTINCT FROM 'ditolak' OR "data_subject_requests"."note" IS NOT NULL

photos_report_or_uploader.name: photos_report_or_uploader
photos_report_or_uploader.value: ("photos"."report_id" IS NULL) = ("photos"."uploader_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("photos"."source" = 'street_view' AND "photos"."report_id" IS NULL AND "photos"."uploader_id" IS NULL)

places_street_view_image_date.name: places_street_view_image_date
places_street_view_image_date.value: ("places"."verification_source" = 'street_view') = ("places"."street_view_image_date" IS NOT NULL) AND ("places"."street_view_image_date" IS NULL OR extract(day from "places"."street_view_image_date") = 1)
